case_name: West Villagers for Responsible Government, Inc., Meisel v. City of North Port, Florida
disposition_text:
ORDER WITHDRAWING OPINION
The petitioner's motion for a written opinion is granted.  This court's per curiam opinion issued on May 3, 2024, is withdrawn, and a written opinion will follow.  The petitioner's motion for additional oral argument is denied.  The respondent's motion to strike supplemental reply is denied.
